findings.finding: A first-time reviewer had to compose template, context, preflight and review paths manually.
findings.repair: Added non-mutating `driftproof onboard` planning plus no-clobber `--apply`, with exact argument vectors and a runtime-derived schema.

findings.finding: Doctor described readiness but did not identify missing requirements or the next machine action.
findings.repair: Added missing_requirements, remediation, recommended_action and next_argv while retaining credential-value privacy.

findings.finding: There was no credential-free one-command demonstration of the green-build semantic failure.
findings.repair: Added transparent safe/unsafe dbt fixtures and `make judge-demo`, which runs identical build-only baselines, DriftProof reviews, independent bundle verification and a hash-bearing receipt.

findings.finding: The first demo implementation ran baseline dbt from the repository root and created judge-demo.duckdb there.
findings.repair: Execute each baseline inside its copied fixture with the qualified project dbt binary; assert Git status hash is unchanged across the demonstration.

findings.finding: Schema clone-independence test encoded a brittle historical file count.
findings.repair: Assert required schema members and equality instead of a magic count.

findings.finding: A caller could accidentally target an existing judge-output path.
findings.repair: No code change required: the script already refuses any existing or symlink output. The first hostile probe failed closed before execution.
